title: turn error card (embedded)
description: A failed turn, structured so a client can draw it: what failed, which model, and each model the harness fell back to. The value under the `dev.agentpod.turn_error` content key of the room's error notice (`m.text`), whose `body` stays the readable fallback. The hub clips every string to its bound rather than drop the card, and omits a field it has no text for. Mirrors AgentPod's `TurnErrorCard` and the hub's `turnErrorCard` (`apps/hub/src/services/acp/turn-error.ts`). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The content's minor version. AgentPod sends 1. Additive changes raise it; a reader draws a higher version best-effort, never drops it.

kind.description: What kind of failure ended the turn, from AgentPod's TurnErrorKind (the hub sends only the listed values). Open to readers: a value not listed in x-treaty-known-values is valid and is drawn generically, never dropped.

message.description: The provider's or harness's own words.

provider.description: The provider of the model that failed, when known.

model.description: The model that failed, when known.

retryable.description: Whether trying again may work, when the harness said.

attempts.description: Each model tried, in order: the first is the one asked for, the rest what the harness fell back to. Omitted rather than sent empty.

provider.description: The attempt's provider; `unknown` when the harness did not say.

model.description: The attempt's model; `unknown` when the harness did not say.

kind.description: What kind of failure ended this attempt, from AgentPod's TurnErrorKind (the hub sends only the listed values). Open to readers: a value not listed in x-treaty-known-values is valid and is drawn generically, never dropped.
